nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 用 and、but、or、because、so 清楚表達添加、轉折、選擇、原因與結果。

naturalExamples.text: I have a pencil and an eraser.
The bag is old, but it is clean.
Do you want tea or water?
I stayed home because I was sick.

wrong.text: Because I was sick, so I stayed home.

better.text: I stayed home because I was sick.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 標準英文通常不用 because 和 so 同時連接同一組原因結果。

wrong.text: I was tired, but I went to bed early.

better.text: I was tired, so I went to bed early.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 早睡是疲累的結果，so 比 but 更符合邏輯。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 下雨了，所以我們待在室內。

wrong.text: It rained, because we stayed inside.

better.text: It rained, so we stayed inside.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 前句是原因，後句是結果，使用 so。
兩項是添加關係，不是轉折。

nodes.titleEn: Can, Will, and Be Going To
nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 用 can 表能力、will 表即時決定或預測、going to 表計畫或有跡象的預測。

naturalExamples.text: We are going to visit Grandma.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: can 後面的動詞使用原形。
will 後直接接原形，不加 to。

wrong.text: We going to make a cake tomorrow.

better.text: We are going to make a cake tomorrow.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: going to 前需要正確的 be。

notesZh: can、will 與 going to 不能全部翻成同一個「會」；資料庫保留各自的溝通功能。
